author: Cyclops
body:
IP & Version: http://avicus.net/forums/6aaf332fa
Scenario: Kings & Energy Drain Cto4

Kings
1 player on each team is a king. If king dies, team loses. Kings has buffs.

Energy Drain
Every 10 mins, 1 xp level will be removed from you. If you dont have xp by 10 mins, you die. You start with 1 xp level.

Winners: Emmy, Sulo, Tino (King), Slicorn, and Merlin
GG
